disclaimer: Hours and eligibility change. Rows are curated from public pages, not live booking APIs. Assiette must not claim remaining stock.

distributions.name: Linkee at ESS'Pace
distributions.address: 15 rue Jean Antoine de Baïf, 75013 Paris
distributions.eligibility: All students. Create a Linkee account, book the distribution, bring student card or certificat de scolarité, and a bag. One parcel per student per site.
distributions.notes: Rescued produce and staples. Not a plated restaurant meal.
distributions.french_hint: Bonjour, je viens chercher mon panier Linkee. Voici ma carte étudiante.

distributions.name: Linkee at La Maison Bleue
distributions.address: 24 avenue de la Porte de Montmartre, 75018 Paris
distributions.eligibility: All students. Book on Linkee, bring student proof and a bag.
distributions.notes: Evening slot in the 18th, useful when CROUS RUs are already closed. Linkee’s own page lists 19:00–20:00; Maison étudiante still lists 18:30–20:00 — confirm before travelling.
distributions.french_hint: Bonjour, je viens chercher mon panier Linkee. Voici ma carte étudiante.

distributions.name: Linkee at Smart Food
distributions.eligibility: All students. Book on Linkee, bring student proof and a bag.
distributions.french_hint: Bonjour, je viens chercher mon panier Linkee. Voici ma carte étudiante.

distributions.name: Cop1 at Césure
distributions.eligibility: Students with a student card or certificat de scolarité. Register for a basket on cop1.fr (Paris). New baskets typically go online on Sundays.
distributions.notes: Food and hygiene. Contents vary. Cop1 Paris currently shows holiday closure until rentrée; Maison étudiante still lists this Wednesday slot — confirm on cop1.fr before travelling.
distributions.french_hint: Bonjour, je suis inscrit·e pour un panier Cop1. Voici ma carte étudiante.

distributions.name: Cop1 at Maison étudiante Bastille
distributions.eligibility: Students with student proof. Register on cop1.fr.
distributions.notes: Two evening slots at the city student house. Cop1 Paris currently shows holiday closure until rentrée; confirm on cop1.fr before travelling.
distributions.french_hint: Bonjour, je suis inscrit·e pour un panier Cop1. Voici ma carte étudiante.

distributions.name: Cop1 at 24 quai d'Austerlitz
distributions.eligibility: Students with student proof. Register on cop1.fr.
distributions.notes: Weekend slot. Cop1 Paris currently shows holiday closure until rentrée; hours differ across university pages — recheck Cop1 before travelling.
distributions.french_hint: Bonjour, je suis inscrit·e pour un panier Cop1. Voici ma carte étudiante.

distributions.name: Restos du Cœur × CROUS (Francis de Croisset)
distributions.eligibility: Students housed in Paris (75) who meet Restos resource ceilings. First visit is an on-site enrolment interview; bring ID, housing proof, and income/charge documents.
distributions.notes: Student-dedicated centre in CROUS premises. Not a drop-in RU meal.
distributions.french_hint: Bonjour, je viens pour une première inscription à l'aide alimentaire étudiante.

distributions.name: Restos du Cœur — boulevard Mortier
distributions.eligibility: Enrolment interview on site. Bring ID and supporting documents.
distributions.notes: Saturday morning youth/student distribution. Confirm current hours before travelling.
distributions.french_hint: Bonjour, je viens pour l'aide alimentaire. Quels documents faut-il pour l'entretien ?

distributions.name: Restos du Cœur at QJ Louvre
distributions.eligibility: Young people / students; enrolment interview. Bring ID and supporting documents.
distributions.french_hint: Bonjour, je viens pour l'aide alimentaire au QJ. Voici ma pièce d'identité.

distributions.name: Secours Populaire — antenne Bayet
distributions.eligibility: Students who live or study in Paris, after an interview, typically with a reste-à-vivre criterion. Appointment by email: etudiants@secourspopparis.org.
distributions.notes: Not a walk-up basket. Mail first.
distributions.french_hint: Bonjour, je suis étudiant·e et je viens pour un premier entretien d'aide alimentaire.

distributions.name: Secours Populaire — Francis de Croisset
distributions.eligibility: Sorbonne Université students. Walk-in (no appointment). Maison étudiante lists this permanence separately from the Restos du Cœur centre at 8 rue Francis de Croisset.
distributions.notes: Not a plated CROUS meal. Distinct from Restos du Cœur at number 8 on the same street.
distributions.french_hint: Bonjour, je viens pour la permanence Secours Populaire. Voici ma carte Sorbonne Université.

distributions.name: Secours Populaire — Jussieu (Sorbonne Université)
distributions.address: Espace Vie Étudiante, 4 place Jussieu, 75005 Paris
distributions.eligibility: Primarily Sorbonne Université students. Appointment at the student life desk.
distributions.notes: Campus permanence, not a city-wide drop-in.
distributions.french_hint: Bonjour, je viens pour la permanence Secours Populaire. Voici ma carte Sorbonne Université.

distributions.name: Ordre de Malte — Foodtruck Solidaire
distributions.eligibility: Student card or certificat de scolarité; live in Paris or an adjacent commune. Online reservation mandatory.
distributions.notes: Short window. Hot dish with vegetarian option when stock allows.
distributions.french_hint: Bonjour, j'ai réservé un panier repas. Voici ma carte étudiante.

distributions.name: L'Équipage Solidaire — Delivraide pickup
distributions.eligibility: Students and people in need; contact the association for the current procedure.
distributions.notes: They also mention home delivery of parcels — confirm by email.
distributions.french_hint: Bonjour, je viens récupérer un panier. Voici ma carte étudiante.

distributions.name: Altrimenti — paniers fruits et légumes
distributions.eligibility: Solidarity produce baskets; hours vary with events. Mail animation@altrimenti-asso.org.
distributions.notes: Not every listed hour is a student distribution. Recheck before travelling.
distributions.french_hint: Bonjour, je viens pour un panier solidaire. Est-ce ouvert aux étudiant·es aujourd'hui ?

distributions.name: Un jour, je serai — colis en résidence
distributions.eligibility: Mostly students living alone in university residences, via a weekly signup link.
distributions.notes: Do not advertise as open-to-all without the weekly link.
distributions.french_hint: Bonjour, je suis inscrit·e via le lien de la résidence. Voici ma carte étudiante.

distributions.name: Happy Toque — Maison étudiante Bastille
distributions.eligibility: Student-oriented social restaurant inside the Maison étudiante. Confirm current student tariff on site.
distributions.notes: Useful evening backup when CROUS RUs are closed. Price is indicative.
distributions.french_hint: Bonjour, le menu étudiant, s'il vous plaît.
